title: Averages & range
examples: Teacher, how do I find the average of these numbers?
When should I use the median instead of the mean?
What is the difference between the mode and the median?

explain.say: Today we learn about finding averages. We look at three ways to find an average. These are the mean, the median, and the mode.

The mean is what most people call the average. You add up all the numbers and then divide by how many numbers there are. For example, if you have two numbers, four and six, you add them up to ten. Then you divide ten by two, which gives you five. So the mean is five.

items: Divide by the count of numbers

explain.say: The median is the middle number when you line up all your numbers. First you must put the numbers in order from smallest to largest. If you have five numbers, the median is the third number in the line. For example, the numbers one, two, five, eight, and ten have a median of five.

The mode is the number that appears most often in your set of numbers. It is the most popular number in the group. For example, if you have the numbers two, three, three, and five, the number three appears twice. So the mode is three.

You should use the median when there are very big or very small numbers. These extreme numbers can pull the mean away from the true middle. For example, if most scores are around ten, but one score is one hundred, the median is a better average to use. The mean would be too high because of that one big score.

faq.q: What is the range of a set of numbers?
faq.a: The range is the difference between the highest number and the lowest number. You take the biggest number and subtract the smallest number from it. You might also be asked to find the range when calculating averages.
asks: How do I find the spread?
What is the difference between range and mean?

faq.q: If I have an even number of data points, how do I find the median?
faq.a: If you have an even amount of numbers, you must find the two middle numbers. Then you add those two middle numbers together and divide by two. For example, for four numbers, you average the second and third numbers.
asks: What if there are four numbers?
How do I find the middle two?

faq.q: Can a set of numbers have more than one mode?
faq.a: Yes, a set can have more than one mode. If two or more numbers appear the same highest number of times, then all those numbers are the modes. We sometimes call this bimodal or multimodal.
asks: What if two numbers repeat the same amount?

faq.q: Is the mean always the best average to use?
faq.a: No, the mean is not always the best average. If your data has extreme values, the median is usually a better choice. The median is not affected by those very high or very low numbers.
asks: Should I always use the median?

faq.q: Do I have to put the numbers in order to find the mode?
faq.a: No, you do not have to put the numbers in order to find the mode. You just need to count how many times each number appears. The most frequent number is the mode no matter the order.

facts: The mean is calculated by summing all values and dividing by the count.
The median is the exact middle value when data is ordered.
The mode is the value that occurs with the greatest frequency.
The range is found by subtracting the minimum value from the maximum value.

quiz.say: Find the mean of these three numbers: two, four, and six.
quiz.why: You add two plus four plus six to get twelve. Then you divide twelve by three numbers, which gives you four.

wrong.1: This is the sum of the numbers, not the average.
wrong.2: This is just the smallest number in the set.
wrong.3: This is the largest number in the set.

quiz.say: What is the median of the following set: five, one, nine, three, seven?
quiz.why: When you put the numbers in order, five is exactly in the middle position.

wrong.0: This is the second largest number, not the middle one.
wrong.1: This is the sum of the smallest and largest numbers.
wrong.3: This is the smallest number, not the middle one.

quiz.say: In the set of scores: 10, 12, 15, 12, 10, 12, what is the mode?
quiz.why: The number twelve appears three times, which is more than any other number.

wrong.1: The number ten only appears twice in the set.
wrong.2: The number fifteen only appears one time.
wrong.3: This is an average, not the most frequent number.
